{{Top|leg}}
'''D435''' was a [[G1 series equipment operator droid]] that worked for the [[Tredway family]] in the mines of the [[Sil'Lume asteroid belt]]. It saved [[Dena Tredway]] shortly after [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Sebastian Parnell]] destroyed the asteroid base. After Dena was delivered to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] for transport to [[Ire Eleazari]]'s asteroid, D435 deactivated itself to avoid Imperial capture.
